baselineComparison.note: First Load JS matches the prior recorded snapshot at 1 kB resolution (no regression in bundle table). VS-75 additionally removes an unnecessary client boundary on the analytics range control and fixes production build compatibility for deferred telemetry (see nextConstraintsNote).

nextConstraintsNote: As of Next.js 15.5, `next/dynamic` with `{ ssr: false }` cannot be used directly inside Server Components. Optional shell telemetry when profiling is off uses `apps/web/src/components/deferred-client-perf-telemetry.tsx` (Client Component wrapper). When `NEXT_PUBLIC_VS_CLIENT_PERF=1`, the dashboard layout renders `ClientPerfTelemetry` synchronously so Web Vitals timing stays comparable.
